title: Sentry
definition: Sentry is a leading error tracking and performance monitoring platform. It hooks into the global error handlers of the browser (`window.onerror`) and automatically uploads rich context, source maps, and breadcrumbs.
simpleExplanation: The industry standard tool for catching bugs in production.

basic: What is the core concept of Sentry?

answers.question: Define Sentry.
answers.answer: Sentry is a key non-functional requirement for robust frontend systems.
